contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (9396.50) on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (9396.50) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (9396.50)
contributions.detail: 13 Schedule A rows sum to 100 + 500 + 250 + 100 + 1000 + 275 + 1000 + 200 + 50 + (-328.50) + 2000 + 2000 + 2250 = 9,396.50 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal AND its printed total AND the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. THE SIDE CLOSES ONLY WITH THE NEGATIVE SIGN KEPT on row 10 ('Costco Reimbursment', printed '-328.50' with an explicit leading minus): dropping the sign or treating it as positive puts the side 657.00 over. This is the addendum-I4 negative-contribution class, live. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 9396.50 (this is the cycle's first report, so period == year-to-date) and is never summed as an increment. Both in-kind conventions were tested and are identical here: no cell carries an in-kind marker and the v. 4.20 form prints no in-kind line.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (9266.96) on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' (9266.96) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (9266.96)
expenditures.detail: 15 Schedule B rows sum to 605.16 + 2000.00 + 567.20 + 1152.93 + 1154.50 + 1025 + 10 + 71.32 + 225 + 600 + 80.43 + 46.55 + 68.83 + 1640.90 + 19.14 = 9,266.96 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E YTD 9266.96 is the cumulative and is never summed. The 15-row grid is COMPLETELY FULL, so the addendum-F1 'ledger continues below the last printed rule' trap was screened explicitly: a 500 dpi strip of the white space between the grid's bottom rule (82.11) and the printed 'Subtotal for this page' label rendered only the candidate box and the subtotal itself — no entry — and the side already closes to the cent without one. Per addendum E1/F5 the filing fee on row 1 was not corroborated from any other filing.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — both conventions tested on both sides and they are identical: no row is marked in-kind and the v. 4.20 form prints no separate in-kind line, so monetary-only == monetary-plus-in-kind, and both close (9,396.50 / 9,266.96).
itemized.escalation_note: 900 dpi tight value crops: p2 r1 rendered '100', p2 r13 rendered '2250', p2 r14 (one band past the last entry) rendered EMPTY; p3 r1 rendered '605.16', p3 r15 rendered '19.14', p3 r15's DATE cell rendered '6-30-20' (settling that the last expenditure really is dated a week after the filer's own 6/23/20 report date). Plus a 500 dpi strip of p3 BELOW the grid's last rule (the F1 trap screen), which rendered only the 'Name of Candidate / Andrea Allen' box and 'Subtotal for this page $ 9266.96'.

itemized.notes: ANDREA ALLEN, 2020, County Recorder, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20'. A TYPED fillable form printed and re-scanned — every figure is machine type except the Office field, which is the only handwritten entry on the filing and reads 'Utah County Recorder' in blue ink. FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' LAST — the addendum-I3 shape, located by content. NO CHECKLIST DECOY: exactly one page carries the summary labels (p4) and every box on it holds a figure. Report type: the filled radio is 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election'; amendment = No; the Date box, the Date of Report boxes on pp2-4 ('June 23, 2020') and the clerk's date stamp ('20 JUN 23 PM 3:47') all agree on 23 June 2020. CHANNEL/PAGE-FACE CONFLICT ON THE REPORT LABEL, recorded and not adjudicated: index.csv's reporting_period reads 'Andrea Allen - 10/27/2020' and the county's own FILENAME says '4-15-22-Primary', while the page is a 7-days-pre-PRIMARY report dated 23 June 2020. The page face governs. THE COUNTY'S REDACTION IS PER-CELL ON THIS FILING and that is the document, not a failed read (addendum I1): the candidate's own address, phone and signature on p1 are blacked out, the three 'Andrea Allen' rows on Schedule A have their whole address cell blacked out, and the OTHER TEN Schedule A rows are published entirely IN THE CLEAR with full street lines. Every one of those was reduced to city/state at read time and no street line or post-office box reached this record, not even a note. Schedule B on this form has a REAL PURPOSE column and all 15 rows fill it. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): no inversion on either schedule. All six row-index traps screened: first written entry is band 1 on both pages (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, no entry below the last rule (crop-proved on p3, whose grid is FULL), and no doubled band — both grids are uniform-pitch and each side closes to the cent. Box A prints a typed '0' (a numeral, not a nil mark). Box F = 9396.50 = A + B and the close balance 129.54 = F - D, so the filer's own ladder is internally consistent.
